queries.evidence_chain:
SELECT ec.*, c."Codice stabile" claim_code,c.Stato claim_status,
            e.Esito evidence_outcome,e.Argomentazione argument
            FROM v_evidence_chains ec JOIN claims c ON c._record_id=ec.claim_id

queries.task39b_cases:
SELECT json_extract(j.value,'$.model') model,
            json_extract(j.value,'$.role') role, COUNT(*) cases,
            SUM(json_extract(j.value,'$.metrics.passed')) passed
            FROM observations o, json_each(o.Descrizione,'$.cases') j
            WHERE o."Codice stabile" LIKE 'observations-giada-task39b-architecture-result-%'
            GROUP BY model,role
queries.task39b_failed_channels:
SELECT json_extract(c.value,'$.channel') channel,
            COUNT(*) failures, AVG(json_extract(c.value,'$.nrmse')) mean_nrmse,
            MAX(json_extract(c.value,'$.rmse_ma_cm2')) worst_absolute_rmse_ma_cm2
            FROM observations o, json_each(o.Descrizione,'$.cases') j,
            json_each(j.value,'$.metrics.channels') c
            WHERE o."Codice stabile" LIKE 'observations-giada-task39b-architecture-result-%'
            AND json_extract(j.value,'$.model')='joint_wbase_h8_c1_r0'
            AND json_extract(j.value,'$.role')='development'
            AND json_extract(c.value,'$.passed')=0 GROUP BY channel ORDER BY failures DESC

precedents.Nome: Task 1b — Gate m limitato dal budget, non da dati o capacita
precedents.Descrizione: La matrice fattoriale preregistrata isola il budget di ottimizzazione come causa robusta del limite residuo. Densita dei dati, width e supervisione ausiliaria dei rate non superano la soglia causale del 20% come effetti principali.
precedents.Risultato: Il vincitore selezionato solo sul development, base-w16-endpoint_only a 50000 step, ottiene fresh macro RMSE 0.0022578625, zero violazioni e rollout RMSE 0.0003801586 a 1000 passi. In-support RMSE 0.0002378306 e OOD-dt 0.0001411297; il residuo e concentrato OOD-voltage (0.0063946271), soprattutto nell'extrapolazione di tau. Gate scientifico 1e-3 non superato; gate ingegneristico 2.5e-3 superato.
precedents.Incertezza: Una variante non selezionata ha RMSE fresh 0.0018670684 ma non puo sostituire il vincitore senza cherry-picking. Gli effetti dei fattori mostrano interazioni, pur senza effetti principali robusti. Resta da misurare quanto l'errore OOD-voltage venga amplificato nel sistema accoppiato.
precedents.Limitazioni: Solo gate m di Ca_HVA sotto voltage clamp costante. Nessuna conclusione su traiettorie V variabili, gate h, canale completo o neurone multicompartimentale.

precedents.Descrizione: Due interventi ortogonali riparano il rollout physical-tau: supervisione esplicita dei rate e loss multi-orizzonte. Il limite della Task 2 non era capacità insufficiente ma identificabilità dell'obiettivo endpoint.
precedents.Risultato: Vincitore development rate_supervision: score 2.706e-5 contro 9.033e-4 endpoint-only (33.4x migliore). Fresh macro RMSE 1.733e-5; rollout1000 0.002619; h_inf RMSE 0.001517; log(tau_h) RMSE 0.01543; zero violazioni. Multi-horizon conferma indipendentemente la diagnosi e ottiene fresh rollout1000 0.002494. Entrambi superano il direct-z Task 2 congelato a 0.003694.
precedents.Incertezza: La selezione development favorisce rate_supervision, mentre multi-horizon è leggermente migliore su alcune metriche fresh; il fresh non può essere usato per cambiare il vincitore. Resta da testare il comportamento con V variabile e nel canale m+h accoppiato.
precedents.Limitazioni: Ca_HVA.h isolato sotto voltage clamp costante; non prova ancora validità embedded, coupling con m, corrente analitica o traiettorie di voltaggio endogene.

precedents.Nome: IE-P5 standard refit improves accuracy; balanced loses; tabulation trades memory for graph speed
precedents.Risultato:
# IE-P5 â€” Accuracy repair and inference deployment

Kaggle v1 completed successfully at scientific revision
`5825ea21be144342e16102f42b84bc79f2c789ba`. All 138 timing preflights passed,
with zero CUDA Graph failures. Local audit independently replayed all 23 maps;
maximum CPU/GPU forced-path metric discrepancy was 5.96e-7.

## Accuracy

The standard refit reduced historical closed-loop voltage RMSE by
4.08x / 4.84x / 3.48x for seeds 17/29/43, to 0.00958 / 0.00826 / 0.00912 mV.
Fresh gate RMSE was 0.000628 / 0.000749 / 0.000581. All standard refits passed
imposed-path gate criteria. However, fresh maximum gate errors remained
0.01168 / 0.01364 / 0.01041 (limit 0.01); calcium maxima remained
5.047e-6 / 5.182e-6 / 6.107e-6 mM (limit 5e-6). Seed43 also failed historical
voltage maximum (0.11471 mV versus 0.1). No learned candidate passed joint quality.

The balanced-loss package was worse than standard in all three seeds on fresh
gate RMSE, imposed-path RMSE and historical voltage RMSE. This contradicts the
registered package, not each extra term separately. Development selected 30k
steps for standard and 10k for balanced. Gains against old frozen checkpoints
conflate additional budget, new data and identically reset Adam moments;
they do not establish that budget alone caused the improvement.

## Execution

All six 0.25mV neural tables passed sampled conversion tolerance (maximum map
delta 2.16e-5â€“2.32e-5, limit 5e-5); all 1mV tables failed it
(3.45e-4â€“3.71e-4). Fine tables largely preserve neural bias, not repair it.
At batch642, CUDA Graph fine deployment saves about 16.5â€“17.3% versus formula
and about 37% versus its MLP. Ordinary compiled deployment remains slower than
formula. Fine tables occupy 87,176 bytes versus 9,420 bytes of network weights
and scales: about 9.25x memory. This is tabulation of learned predictions,
not a new neural architecture, parameter compression or direct MLP speedup.
The analytic LUT passes quality and saves about 17.0% in the same graph backend.
These are resident-core measurements, not end-to-end simulation speedups.

## Attribution and limits

Oracle coefficient interventions apply ONLY to the old frozen IE-P4 models.
Replacing z with exact coefficients reduces their historical voltage RMSE
4.00â€“7.37x. Replacing the calcium coefficient group strongly reduces calcium
error. Replacing u alone does not repair it and worsens calcium maxima in all
three seeds; compensation and nonlinear interaction remain possible.
These interventions neither identify a unique cause nor attribute errors in
the new refits, which were not subjected to these swaps. Oracles are not
selection/cost eligible. Opened Task35 traces are diagnostic, not a fresh native
confirmation. No operational candidate is promoted and no new run is launched.

Raw results, checkpoints, per-family probes, timing blocks, selection freeze
and independent audit are retained in `results/ie_p5_kaggle_v1/`.
precedents.Limitazioni: No automatic promotion or new native/morphology confirmation. Fixed-input resident timing excludes host RNG,events,transfers. Outside voltage domain not covered; tables hold boundary coefficients, denseMLP sees actualV. Tabulation cannot repair model bias by itself and its compiler error is measured separately. More training does not remove denseMLP inference cost. No OpenEvolve or custom kernels. Budget/data/Adam-reset confounded versus parent; balanced terms not separately ablated; oracle swaps only old frozen models; no end-to-end speed claim.

precedents.Nome: IE-P6 learned local maps pass scoped quality and graph cost; temporal objective fails
precedents.Risultato:
# 🔬 IE-P6 — audited result

Kaggle v1 COMPLETE; scientific revision `c5b3819eeaa6b8e4522129ee309e468cb4fa2d8a`
verified in worker revision file, final report and setup log. About9.5minutes
notebook runtime,30ktraining steps.210timing cells and210numeric preflights,
zero graph failures. Read-only local audit replayed all35maps on CPU with maximum
path-metric discrepancy1.17e-6. Regenerated path float64 discrepancy2.84e-14mV
(cross-platform elementary math); saved paths used for CPU replay.

## ✅ Main result: learned local maps

All six learned piecewise-linear coefficient operators pass ALL registered
quality gates and the batch642 CUDA Graph resident-cost criterion (median
saved fraction>=10%, paired interval lower bound>0). No automatic promotion.

| Map | Fresh gate RMSE | Path gate RMSE | Historical V RMSE mV | Graph saving vs formula |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| local81 seed17 | 4.02e-5 | 8.67e-5 | 0.000713 | 10.12% |
| local81 seed29 | 3.97e-5 | 9.22e-5 | 0.001115 | 10.05% |
| local81 seed43 | 3.98e-5 | 8.69e-5 | 0.001010 | 10.63% |
| local161 seed17 | 1.92e-5 | 5.12e-5 | 0.001007 | 10.59% |
| local161 seed29 | 2.16e-5 | 4.26e-5 | 0.001312 | 10.49% |
| local161 seed43 | 1.95e-5 | 6.83e-5 | 0.000979 | 10.70% |

Local81 occupies11,084bytes,local16121,964bytes including scale, versus9,420bytes
for MLP64 and87,176bytes for fine table deployment. This is NOT a reduction in
parameters versus MLP64. It is a local learned numerical coefficient table,
initialized from neural predictions and optimized against analytic teacher
targets, not a dense neural-network speedup. Initialization projection error
is separately retained. First selected local161 checkpoints are1k/10k/1k;
local813k/30k/30k. More updates are not monotonically better: dev scores can
deteriorate, especially local161. Freeze before fresh prevented fresh selection.

The analytic .25mV LUT still passes quality and saves25.32% in the SAME graph
benchmark. Thus learned local maps do not dominate the best numerical baseline;
they provide a smaller-memory cost/quality tradeoff. Ordinary compiled local
costs are near parity with formula, with intervals spanning parity, not a
confirmed speed advantage. The two local resolutions have similar costs.
Historical error below formula in one case is compatible with error cancellation,
not proof of greater physical accuracy than the analytic equations.

## 🧪 Factorial matrix

Standard continuation A reduces joint fresh gate/path score versus its P5parent
30.2%,34.7%,12.1% for17/29/43. A passes all quality gates2/3; seed17 still fails
historical V maximum (0.1111mV versus0.1). Continuation is useful but does not
isolate additional updates from new training data/optimizer reset/LR change.

Targeted B improves the registered worst-case joint score versus A by
